Task acceptance not fulfilled: the review found that the candidate does not satisfy source issue #1211. Change the candidate so it satisfies everything the issue requires; the reviewer's acceptance evidence:
- At candidate head, `ops/gpg-dsh.sh` lines 176-178 still call `gpgconf --homedir $legacy_seed --kill gpg-agent` unconditionally after `has_legacy_seed` succeeds.
- The guard exists only in the added `patches/issue-1211-legacy-homedir.patch`; that patch is not applied to `ops/gpg-dsh.sh` in the candidate.
- The eight new tests at `tests/gpg-dsh.test.ts` lines 813-835 expect no `gpgconf` calls for symlink and missing legacy homedirs, so they fail against the unchanged helper.

[P1] Apply the legacy homedir guard so the new tests pass

The new symlink and missing cases expect cleanup to skip the legacy agent whenever `legacy_seed` is not an owned directory, but candidate `ops/gpg-dsh.sh` still calls `gpgconf --homedir $legacy_seed --kill gpg-agent` unconditionally in `discard_legacy_seed`; the guard exists only in the unapplied `patches/issue-1211-legacy-homedir.patch`. As committed, `gpgconfCalls` is non-empty and all eight new cases fail at this assertion.
